text: I build AI that turns classical Islamic legal texts into structured and searchable knowledge for the Legal Knowledge Platform. I cover the whole ML cycle from data and experiments to evaluation and integration. The focus is accuracy and reliability at scale.

I validated and deployed object detection models for client computer vision pipelines. I also built and maintained the annotated image and video datasets behind them. Tracking down annotation errors and edge cases made the models more robust.
Selected through a competitive assessment. I completed four end‑to‑end capstone projects.
Research on brain tumour detection and distracted driving as well as tea leaf disease and mango ripeness.

role: B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering
